tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250klong gsal rdor snying zhi khro sku gsum chog skor las zur bton rdzas rtags sna bdun dbang rgyas bsdus ni/ 1$0000300hūm̐: sangs rgyas bsod nams rdzogs pa'i mtshan dpe las: legs par byung ba'i bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bkra shis yon tan phun sum tshogs par shog: aṣ+ṭa maṅga laṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

rdzas brgyad ni: sngon tshe bcom ldan thub pa'i dbang po la: bsod nams mthu ldan tshangs pa la sogs pas: phul pa'i yon tan rdzas mchog bkra shis kyi: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: maṅga laṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sna bdun ni: 'khor los sgyur rgyal mthus byung rgyal srid bdun: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la mnga' gsol ba'i: dbang mchog bskur bas bsod nams tshogs rdzogs te: 'khor los sgyur ba'i yon tan thob par shog: ma ṇi rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: ༈ bsdu na/ bkra shis rtags rdzas rgyal srid sna bdun ni/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i mtshan dpe las byung bkra shis rtags// sngon tshe ston pas byin rlabs rdzas mchog brgyad// bsod nams mthu las byung ba'i rgyal srid bdun// deng 'dir skal ldan slob mar dbang bskur ro// srid zhi'i bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog /maṅga laṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
